title: erucastrum elatum var. microspermum
intro: Erucastrum elatum var. microspermum, commonly known as a type of wild mustard, is a plant species in the Brassicaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving respiratory health, due to its therapeutic actions such as expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The plant's bioactive constituents, including glucosinolates and isothiocyanates, are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties. Further research is needed to fully understand the effects of Erucastrum elatum var. microspermum on human health.
